detail: The examples/ to fixtures/ rename broke CI twice in one session and both misses had the same shape. First the sweep rule excluded any path preceded by a segment, which correctly skipped the foreign examples/ directories (a cargo convention dir in the Rust SDK, a cloned grpc checkout, two URL paths) but ALSO skipped $ROOT/examples/..., which was ours; that broke linux-hosted and linux-containers. Then the sweep excluded the moved tree itself, so fixtures/compose-fixture/compose-appium-smoke.sh still ran cd "$ROOT/examples/compose-fixture" and android-hosted went red. Remaining breaks fixed here: the compose and qt fixture scripts, the tar excludes in the two Rust backend e2e harnesses, the go.mod module identifiers, and a csproj comment describing the copied layout. The gate added here enumerates nothing, which is the point: it reads every fixtures/<name> and examples/<name> reference out of the tracked files and asks the filesystem whether it resolves, so a missed rename or a deleted fixture fails the build instead of a native gate twenty minutes into CI. It resolves the whole path token against the referencing file's own directory and every ancestor, because fixtures/ is a normal directory name that the protocol crate, the a2ui runner and several SDKs each keep their own of. Historical records and recorded evidence are skipped, since rewriting them would falsify them. Verified by reintroducing the exact android-hosted break and watching the gate name it, then restoring it: 1561 tracked files scanned, all references resolve. FOLLOW-UP: the gate then flagged its own docstring, which names the dead path while explaining the break it exists to prevent. It now reads executable lines only, the same discipline test_check_internal_invocations.py uses, so prose about a dead path cannot trip the rule that forbids it. That reached CI rather than my machine for a reason worth recording: the gate walks `git ls-files`, and when it was first run locally the file was still UNTRACKED, so it never scanned itself. A gate driven by the index must be validated after it is IN the index.
